Record Class TurGitBuildStatus

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.viglet.turing.service.git.TurGitBuildStatus
Record Components:
state - current execution state
logLines - captured output lines from the build process
siteName - name of the deployed SPA page (populated on success)
errorMessage - human-readable error description (populated on failure)
startedAt - ISO-8601 timestamp when the build started
completedAt - ISO-8601 timestamp when the build finished (success or fail)
public record TurGitBuildStatus(TurGitBuildState state, List<String> logLines, String siteName, String errorMessage, String startedAt, String completedAt) extends Record
Immutable snapshot of a git repository build pipeline status.
Since:
2026.2.4
